رَاجِفٌ [Putting into a state of motion, commotion, or agitation. ―
-b2- And also, or حُمَّى رَاجِفٌ,] A fever attended with quaking, or shivering: (O, Msb, K:) deviating from rule [because حُمَّى is fem.]. (Msb.) ―
-b3- [The fem., with ة, app. applied to a she-camel or the like, occurs, accord. to Freytag, in the Deewán el-Hudhaleeyeen, as meaning Moving the head in going along.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
